name: Coastal Breezes Property Management — After-Hours Urgent Triage

nodes.name: VOIP Inbound Webhook
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Entry point for all VOIP call/text data from Twilio or Vonage. Simulates delivery of inbound calls and SMS transcriptions to the triage workflow.
INPUT: POST body with fields: CallerID, Timestamp, MessageTranscription, PropertyType, UrgencyScore.
OUTPUT: Passes the raw body plus headers/params/query to the Check Urgency Level switch node. CRITICAL: user data is always under $json.body.*
CONFIG: Register this webhook URL in your Twilio/Vonage dashboard as the SMS/Call webhook endpoint. Path: coastal-breezes-triage.
ERRORS: 404 = wrong path configured; 405 = method mismatch (must be POST).
PINNED DATA: 75 items representing all test scenarios from the CSV. Items 1-3 test all primary branches (Life Safety, Non-Urgent, Moderate).

nodes.name: Check Urgency Level
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Categorizes each inbound VOIP item into Life Safety (output 0), Moderate (output 1), Non-Urgent (output 2), or Unclassified (output 3/extra) based on UrgencyScore and keyword matching.
INPUT: Webhook body with UrgencyScore (1-10) and MessageTranscription string. Access via $json.body.*
OUTPUT: output 0 = Life Safety Alert (score>=8 OR 14 keywords), output 1 = Moderate Issue (score 5-7 OR 10 keywords including ac/hvac), output 2 = Non-Urgent Request (score<=4 OR 12 keywords), output 3 = Unclassified (fallbackOutput: extra — catch-all).
RULE PRIORITY: Rules evaluated in order. Life Safety wins over Moderate. Moderate wins over Non-Urgent. First-match semantics.
CONFIG: fallbackOutput set to 'extra' per typeVersion 3.2 spec — adds a 4th output for unmatched items.
ERRORS: Items with undefined UrgencyScore coerce to 0 under loose validation — routes to Non-Urgent (score<=4). Safe fallback.

nodes.name: Lookup On-Call Technician
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Queries the OnCallRoster table in Airtable to find the on-call technician for the current day of the week.
INPUT: Receives alert items from Switch node outputs 0 (Life Safety) and 1 (Moderate). Both connect to this node's main[0] input.
OUTPUT: Airtable record with fields DayOfWeek, TechnicianName, Phone, Specialty. Returns empty if no roster entry found for today.
KEY EXPRESSION: filterByFormula = ={{ '{DayOfWeek} = "' + $now.toFormat('cccc') + '"' }} — Luxon cccc returns full day name (Monday, Tuesday...Sunday). Produces valid Airtable formula: {DayOfWeek} = "Tuesday"
CONFIG: Replace AIRTABLE_BASE_ID_HERE with your base ID from the Airtable URL. Create table OnCallRoster with columns: DayOfWeek, TechnicianName, Phone, Specialty. Populate with 7 rows from airtable_oncall_roster.csv.
ERRORS: Empty result handled by Technician Found Check downstream. 401=bad token; 404=wrong base or table name (case-sensitive).

nodes.name: Technician Found Check
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Guards the Slack alert path. Only proceeds if Airtable returned a valid technician record with a non-empty TechnicianName. Routes empty or missing results to the error handler.
INPUT: Airtable search result — either a record with TechnicianName populated, or empty.
OUTPUT: TRUE branch (output 0) = TechnicianName is not empty, proceed to Send Urgent Slack Alert. FALSE branch (output 1) = TechnicianName is empty, route to Error Handler — No Technician Found.
EXPRESSION: $json.TechnicianName checked with notEmpty operator (unary/singleValue:true).
CONFIG: No credentials required. typeVersion 2.2 requires conditions.options and conditions.combinator fields.
ERRORS: If Airtable API itself throws (401/404), the Error Trigger catches that instead of this node.

nodes.name: Send Urgent Slack Alert
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Posts a rich formatted alert to #maintenance-alerts Slack channel for all Life Safety and Moderate urgency events once a technician is confirmed on-call.
INPUT: Airtable technician record (TechnicianName, Phone, Specialty in $json). Original VOIP data accessed via cross-node reference $('VOIP Inbound Webhook').first().
OUTPUT: Slack message confirmation. Terminal node for the urgent path.
KEY EXPRESSIONS: All 8 data points in the message — CallerID, PropertyType, UrgencyScore, Timestamp, MessageTranscription from webhook node; TechnicianName, Phone, Specialty from current Airtable $json.
WHY CROSS-NODE REFERENCE: By this point $json contains Airtable data, not webhook data. Must reference original webhook node explicitly.
SLACK v2.3 PARAMS: Uses select/channelId/__rl/messageType/text/otherOptions — NOT resource/operation/channel (those are wrong for v2.3).
CONFIG: Create Slack Bot Token credential in n8n. Bot needs chat:write and channels:read scopes. Invite bot to #maintenance-alerts.
ERRORS: 404=channel not found; 403=missing scopes; rate limit=1msg/sec handled by n8n retry.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets Morning Review
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Appends non-urgent request records to the Google Sheets morning review log so day-staff can follow up during business hours without waking on-call technicians.
INPUT: Non-urgent items from Switch node output 2. $json.body.* still accessible — this is the first node after the webhook on this branch.
OUTPUT: Passes items through after append, chaining to Send Non-Emergency Logged Email.
COLUMNS MAPPED: Timestamp, CallerID, MessageTranscription, PropertyType, UrgencyScore (from $json.body.*); Category=NON-URGENT (static); Status=Pending Review (static). 7 columns total.
Google Sheets v4.5 REQUIRES: columns.mappingMode=defineBelow + columns.schema array (one entry per column). Without schema, the node fails on import.
CONFIG: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with sheet ID from URL. Create tab named exactly: Coastal Breezes Morning Review Log. Add column headers in row 1: Timestamp, CallerID, MessageTranscription, PropertyType, UrgencyScore, Category, Status.
ERRORS: 403=sheet not shared with OAuth account; tab name mismatch=column map error.

nodes.name: Send Non-Emergency Logged Email
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Sends a professional HTML acknowledgment email to the caller confirming their non-urgent request was logged and will be addressed during business hours.
INPUT: Non-urgent items after Google Sheets append. $json.body.* still accessible from original webhook payload.
OUTPUT: Gmail send confirmation. Terminal node for the non-urgent path.
KEY EXPRESSIONS: sendTo = CallerID + '@placeholder.coastalbreezes.com' (PLACEHOLDER — replace with CRM email lookup in production). Reference number = CB-{yyyyMMdd}-{last6digits of CallerID}. All message body fields from $json.body.*
Gmail v2.1 PARAMS: sendTo, subject, emailType='html', message, options={}. No resource/operation fields needed for send.
CONFIG: Create Gmail OAuth2 credential in n8n. Replace CREDENTIAL_ID_HERE. Update sendTo expression with real email lookup logic before production deployment.
ERRORS: 401=OAuth token expired (refresh in n8n credentials); 400=invalid sendTo address (placeholder will fail in prod).

nodes.name: Error Handler — No Technician Found
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Fallback error handler that fires when (a) Airtable returns no on-call technician for today, (b) an item matched no urgency rule (Switch fallback output 3), or (c) the Workflow Error Trigger fires on a runtime exception.
INPUT: Receives from three sources: (1) Technician Found Check FALSE branch, (2) Switch output 3/extra fallback, (3) Workflow Error Trigger. Each source provides a differently-shaped item — ternary expressions handle all three shapes.
OUTPUT: Slack message to #maintenance-alerts with diagnostic context. Terminal node.
TERNARY DEFENSE: $json.body ? $json.body.CallerID : ($json.CallerID || 'Unknown') — handles both webhook-wrapped items and flat error trigger items.
CONFIG: Uses same Slack credential as Send Urgent Slack Alert. Same CREDENTIAL_ID_HERE value.
ERRORS: If this node itself fails (Slack down), there is no further fallback — monitor n8n execution logs for failures of this node.

nodes.name: Workflow Error Trigger
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Catches any unhandled runtime exception thrown by any node in this workflow. Routes error context to the Error Handler for immediate Slack notification.
INPUT: n8n fires this trigger automatically when any node throws an unhandled exception. Item shape: { error: { message, node: { name, type }, execution: {...} } }.
OUTPUT: Error context object passed to Error Handler — No Technician Found node.
CONFIG: No configuration required. Fires automatically for this workflow. Must be in the same workflow (not a sub-workflow) to catch errors from other nodes.
ERRORS: N/A — this is the error catcher itself.
